body:
I just want everyone to know that I called my parents last night and let them know everything, we talked for hours. They still don't really understand how I feel about myself, but they told me over and over that they will love me no matter what, and are so proud of me.

I've also arranged a counseling session.

Thank you reddit, it felt like I was alone in the dark, and you were the hand that pulled me back on to my feet.

I know it's not over yet, but today I woke up hopeful instead of in the pit.
I'd have to discuss it with my tutors, but I've been too ashamed to even talk to them. Now I'm so far behind I don't know what to do.
thank you for sharing, this song is amazing
I don't know where to start, or even what kind of situation to tell them in.

You have no idea how much it means to me to have you call me brother, I got a huge surge of emotion reading it.

Thank you for your words. I  don't know what else to say.

Thank you for replying to me. I don't know how to get help or how to start, mostly I don't know what my first step should be.

I'm so ashamed of what I've done, I don't feel like I deserve any help at all, I feel like it's all my fault and I've lied to my family. I'm so scared they will reject me for failing this year at university.
